answer: Require each agent to lock collateral in a time-release vault before it can earn, and tie its earning weight to that locked stake, not to how many accounts it holds. A sybil swarm then cannot mirror one deposit across a nebula of fake identities: every extra identity demands its own fresh, non-transferable lock, so forging N agents costs N times the capital and N times the lockup, making dilution attacks economically self-defeating.
